hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Join Activities with Age using user_id to map each activity to an age bucket.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Group by age_bucket and calculate total time spent on 'send' and 'open' activities.

hints.title: Query Construction
hints.text: Compute percentage for each activity type as 100.0 * type_time / total_time, rounded to 2 decimal places.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT
    age_bucket,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(IF(activity_type = 'send', time_spent, 0)) / SUM(time_spent), 2) AS send_perc,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(IF(activity_type = 'open', time_spent, 0)) / SUM(time_spent), 2) AS open_perc
FROM Activities
JOIN Age USING (user_id)
GROUP BY age_bucket;
```

complexity.notes: Hash join of activities with age followed by single-key aggregation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separate queries for open and send activities cause multiple table scans.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(K) memory for bucket accumulation hash table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use conditional aggregation with sum(case...) or if(...) in a single pass.

solutions.approach: Conditional Sum Aggregation by Age Bucket
solutions.code:

    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(IF(activity_type = 'open', time_spent, 0)) / SUM(time_spent), 2) AS open_perc

JOIN Age USING (user_id)
GROUP BY age_bucket;

solutions.approach: Conditional Sum Aggregation by Age Bucket
solutions.code:
SELECT
    age_bucket,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN activity_type = 'send' THEN time_spent ELSE 0 END) / SUM(time_spent), 2) AS send_perc,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN activity_type = 'open' THEN time_spent ELSE 0 END) / SUM(time_spent), 2) AS open_perc
FROM Activities
JOIN Age USING (user_id)
GROUP BY age_bucket;

solutions.approach: Pandas Merge and Conditional Groupby Sum
solutions.code:
import pandas as pd

def snap_analysis(activities: pd.DataFrame, age: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    merged = activities.merge(age, on='user_id')
    merged['send_time'] = merged.apply(lambda r: r['time_spent'] if r['activity_type'] == 'send' else 0, axis=1)
    merged['open_time'] = merged.apply(lambda r: r['time_spent'] if r['activity_type'] == 'open' else 0, axis=1)
    grouped = merged.groupby('age_bucket').agg(
        send_time=('send_time', 'sum'),
        open_time=('open_time', 'sum'),
        total_time=('time_spent', 'sum')
    ).reset_index()
    grouped['send_perc'] = (100.0 * grouped['send_time'] / grouped['total_time']).round(2)
    grouped['open_perc'] = (100.0 * grouped['open_time'] / grouped['total_time']).round(2)
    return grouped[['age_bucket', 'send_perc', 'open_perc']]
